body.statement:
For every \((G,P)\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{PNHZ}}\) satisfying the query-local first-jet-determining and fibre-coherence hypotheses, consider a measured endpoint pair \((D_\ell(A),D_\ell(B))\) issued by \(\operatorname{RankPeel}\) as a singleton, pair, baseline-neutrality, or augmented-neutrality query.  That pair belongs to \(\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{stab}}(P_X)\).  If a latent set \(Z\subseteq V\setminus V_0\) is one of the restricted separators used for this query, then
\[
R^{\mathrm{law}}_{P_X}(D_\ell(A),D_\ell(B))
\leq\min\{|D_\ell(A)|,|D_\ell(B)|,|Z|\}.
\]
body.justification: This is the one-way query-specific upper bound on the strict query-regular subclass; first-jet determinacy makes the derivative rank version-invariant, and latent fibre coherence lets the topological lemma bound it without differentiating an outer map.
body.gap: The unchanged published Conditions 1--3 do not imply the two version properties, as certified by the retained boundary counterexample.
body.consumer: After the assumptions are applied, this supplies the upper half of pair and neutrality decisions.
